name: Spitter
abilities: Concentrated slime blast that launches large foes (Vilgax, Kevin 11,000)
Slippery, highly conductive slime that amplifies allies' electric attacks
weaknesses: Purely a one-trick ranged attacker (no documented Weaknesses section on the wiki)
summary: Ben 10,000's green pufferfish alien that inflates and hoses enemies with a pressurised jet of slippery, conductive slime.
traits: Only ever used by Ben 10,000 and Ken on-screen - never by present-day Ben Prime
Five sensory stalks on the head
Appears in the Ultimate Alien intro
notableFeats: Fought Vilgax before switching into Arctiguana (Ben 10,000)
Ben 10,000 used him against Mot Snikrep (Ken 10)
Ken's Spitter drenched Kevin 11,000 to set up Buzzshock's shock (Ken 10)

appearances.designNotes: Green outer skin, pale green underside, yellowish-green eyes joined to the corners of the mouth, dull teeth, black pants, Omnitrix on the stomach. Ken's Spitter is identical.

image.label: OS
image.notes: Only infobox image (unlabelled); OS model sheet render.

scoring.rationale: A single mid-strength ranged slime blast that can bowl over Vilgax-sized foes, plus useful electricity-conducting synergy; otherwise slow, squat and one-dimensional.

notes: Wiki has no Weaknesses section; weaknesses above are editorial inference.
Never used by present-day Ben on-screen (only Ben 10,000 in the OS future episodes and Ken); unlocked off-screen for young Ben per crew statements. Not used in AF/UA/OV.
Also used by Ken (Ken 10) - not counted.
